phases.title: K8S-06 — Networking & Troubleshooting
phases.objective: Build hands-on Kubernetes production operations skills in networking & troubleshooting, including controlled failures, diagnosis, verification, and documentation.

tasks.title: K8S-06.1 — Services and EndpointSlices
tasks.objective: Deploy ClusterIP Services; inspect selectors, ports and EndpointSlices; diagnose missing backends.

tasks.title: K8S-06.2 — Pod-to-Pod Connectivity
tasks.objective: Verify cross-node Pod traffic; inspect CNI configuration; isolate connectivity failures.

tasks.title: K8S-06.3 — CoreDNS and Service Discovery
tasks.objective: Test DNS resolution; inspect CoreDNS logs and configuration; fix a broken lookup.

tasks.title: K8S-06.4 — Ingress Routing and HTTP Errors
tasks.objective: Deploy an ingress controller if feasible; diagnose 404, 502 and 503 responses.

tasks.title: K8S-06.5 — NetworkPolicies and Traffic Isolation
tasks.objective: Verify CNI policy support; implement ingress/egress restrictions; diagnose blocked traffic.

tasks.title: K8S-06.6 — Service Types and External Access
tasks.objective: Compare ClusterIP, NodePort and LoadBalancer behavior; test local exposure safely.

tasks.title: K8S-06.7 — Network Troubleshooting Toolkit
tasks.objective: Use kubectl exec, ephemeral debug containers where supported, curl, dig and logs.

tasks.title: K8S-06.8 — Networking Incident Simulation
tasks.objective: Introduce a selector, DNS or routing fault; investigate, restore service and write a runbook.

phases.title: K8S-07 — Storage & Troubleshooting
phases.objective: Build hands-on Kubernetes production operations skills in storage & troubleshooting, including controlled failures, diagnosis, verification, and documentation.

tasks.title: K8S-07.1 — PV, PVC and StorageClass Fundamentals
tasks.objective: Inspect storage resources, binding modes and reclaim policies.

tasks.title: K8S-07.2 — Local Dynamic Provisioning
tasks.objective: Configure an appropriate local provisioner in kind and verify PVC binding.

tasks.title: K8S-07.3 — PVC Pending Troubleshooting
tasks.objective: Create an unbound claim; investigate capacity, class and provisioner events.

tasks.title: K8S-07.4 — Volume Mount Failures
tasks.objective: Reproduce a safe mount/configuration error; inspect Pod events and fix it.

tasks.title: K8S-07.5 — Access Modes and Scheduling
tasks.objective: Compare RWO, ROX and RWX; test volume/node placement constraints.

tasks.title: K8S-07.6 — StatefulSets and Persistent Data
tasks.objective: Deploy a small stateful workload; test Pod recreation and persistence.

tasks.title: K8S-07.7 — Storage Capacity and Recovery
tasks.objective: Inspect storage usage and simulate bounded full-volume conditions safely.

tasks.title: K8S-07.8 — Storage Incident Simulation
tasks.objective: Troubleshoot a broken volume or PVC and document recovery steps.

phases.title: K8S-08 — Cluster Maintenance & Troubleshooting
phases.objective: Build hands-on Kubernetes production operations skills in cluster maintenance & troubleshooting, including controlled failures, diagnosis, verification, and documentation.

tasks.title: K8S-08.1 — Node Conditions and Maintenance Readiness
tasks.objective: Inspect node conditions, capacity and running workloads before maintenance.

tasks.title: K8S-08.2 — Cordon and Uncordon
tasks.objective: Practice preventing new scheduling and restoring node scheduling.

tasks.title: K8S-08.3 — Drain and Eviction
tasks.objective: Drain a disposable worker node with appropriate workload protections.

tasks.title: K8S-08.4 — PodDisruptionBudget During Maintenance
tasks.objective: Diagnose blocked evictions and evaluate safe maintenance options.

tasks.title: K8S-08.5 — Node Replacement in kind
tasks.objective: Replace a disposable worker node and observe rescheduling.

tasks.title: K8S-08.6 — DaemonSets and Static Pods
tasks.objective: Explain their behavior during node maintenance; inspect examples.

tasks.title: K8S-08.7 — Maintenance Validation Checklist
tasks.objective: Verify workloads, networking, storage and node health after changes.

tasks.title: K8S-08.8 — Maintenance Incident Simulation
tasks.objective: Simulate an interrupted drain or unavailable node; write a recovery runbook.

phases.title: K8S-09 — Kubernetes Upgrades & Troubleshooting
phases.objective: Build hands-on Kubernetes production operations skills in kubernetes upgrades & troubleshooting, including controlled failures, diagnosis, verification, and documentation.

tasks.title: K8S-09.1 — Version Skew and Upgrade Planning
tasks.objective: Review supported component version skew and identify upgrade prerequisites.

tasks.title: K8S-09.2 — API Deprecation Audit
tasks.objective: Identify deprecated APIs in manifests and plan replacements.

tasks.title: K8S-09.3 — Backup and Rollback Preparation
tasks.objective: Document etcd/control plane and workload recovery considerations; snapshot only when supported.

tasks.title: K8S-09.4 — Disposable Cluster Upgrade Strategy
tasks.objective: Plan a safe kind cluster replacement or supported node upgrade test.

tasks.title: K8S-09.5 — Node Upgrade and Drain Workflow
tasks.objective: Practice worker replacement with cordon/drain and PDB checks.

tasks.title: K8S-09.6 — Workload Compatibility Testing
tasks.objective: Test probes, ingress, storage and manifests against a newer Kubernetes version.

tasks.title: K8S-09.7 — Upgrade Failure Investigation
tasks.objective: Diagnose an intentionally incompatible manifest or configuration.

tasks.title: K8S-09.8 — Upgrade Runbook and Post-Checks
tasks.objective: Write preflight, validation, recovery and post-upgrade procedures.

phases.title: K8S-10 — Deployment Strategies & Troubleshooting
phases.objective: Build hands-on Kubernetes production operations skills in deployment strategies & troubleshooting, including controlled failures, diagnosis, verification, and documentation.

tasks.title: K8S-10.1 — Rolling Updates
tasks.objective: Configure Deployment rollingUpdate maxSurge and maxUnavailable.

tasks.title: K8S-10.2 — Rollout Status and History
tasks.objective: Inspect revisions, rollout status and events.

tasks.title: K8S-10.3 — Rollbacks and Recovery
tasks.objective: Deploy a broken image or config and perform a verified rollback.

tasks.title: K8S-10.4 — Readiness and Zero-Downtime
tasks.objective: Test readiness, terminationGracePeriodSeconds and traffic continuity.

tasks.title: K8S-10.5 — Recreate vs Rolling Update
tasks.objective: Compare deployment strategies and expected downtime.

tasks.title: K8S-10.6 — Canary Deployment Fundamentals
tasks.objective: Implement a lightweight canary using separate Deployments and traffic selection.

tasks.title: K8S-10.7 — Deployment Failure Troubleshooting
tasks.objective: Diagnose image pull, readiness and rollout timeout failures.

tasks.title: K8S-10.8 — Release Incident Simulation
tasks.objective: Reproduce a failed release and document detection, rollback and prevention.

phases.title: K8S-11 — Security & RBAC Troubleshooting
phases.objective: Build hands-on Kubernetes production operations skills in security & rbac troubleshooting, including controlled failures, diagnosis, verification, and documentation.

tasks.title: K8S-11.1 — RBAC Roles and Bindings
tasks.objective: Create least-privilege Roles and RoleBindings; test permissions.

tasks.title: K8S-11.2 — ServiceAccounts and Workload Identity Basics
tasks.objective: Inspect service account tokens and configure scoped workload access.

tasks.title: K8S-11.3 — Forbidden Error Troubleshooting
tasks.objective: Reproduce a denied API operation and diagnose with kubectl auth can-i.

tasks.title: K8S-11.4 — Pod Security Standards
tasks.objective: Apply namespace Pod Security Admission labels and diagnose rejected Pods.

tasks.title: K8S-11.5 — Security Contexts
tasks.objective: Configure non-root containers, capabilities and read-only root filesystems.

tasks.title: K8S-11.6 — Secrets and Configuration Safety
tasks.objective: Handle Kubernetes Secrets without committing real credentials or leaking values in logs.

tasks.title: K8S-11.7 — Network Security Controls
tasks.objective: Apply supported NetworkPolicies and validate allowed/blocked paths.

tasks.title: K8S-11.8 — Security Incident Simulation
tasks.objective: Investigate a failed admission or RBAC configuration; document remediation.

phases.title: K8S-12 — Observability & Troubleshooting
phases.objective: Build hands-on Kubernetes production operations skills in observability & troubleshooting, including controlled failures, diagnosis, verification, and documentation.

tasks.title: K8S-12.1 — Cluster Metrics Fundamentals
tasks.objective: Inspect metrics-server and kubectl top; understand limits of resource metrics.

tasks.title: K8S-12.2 — Prometheus Monitoring
tasks.objective: Deploy lightweight monitoring when resources allow; inspect targets and metrics.

tasks.title: K8S-12.3 — Grafana Dashboards
tasks.objective: Create a minimal workload and node health dashboard.

tasks.title: K8S-12.4 — Application and Kubernetes Logs
tasks.objective: Collect and correlate application, Pod and event information.

tasks.title: K8S-12.5 — Alerting Rules
tasks.objective: Define practical alerts for restarts, unavailable replicas and resource pressure.

tasks.title: K8S-12.6 — Troubleshoot Missing Metrics
tasks.objective: Investigate unavailable metrics and failed scrape targets.

tasks.title: K8S-12.7 — SLO and Error Budget Basics
tasks.objective: Define a simple availability SLI/SLO and measurement method.

tasks.title: K8S-12.8 — Observability Incident Simulation
tasks.objective: Detect an injected failure with metrics/logs and write a timeline.

phases.title: K8S-13 — Production Incident Simulations
phases.objective: Build hands-on Kubernetes production operations skills in production incident simulations, including controlled failures, diagnosis, verification, and documentation.

tasks.title: K8S-13.1 — CrashLoopBackOff Incident
tasks.objective: Diagnose a restarting workload without reading the answer first.

tasks.title: K8S-13.2 — ImagePullBackOff Incident
tasks.objective: Troubleshoot image name, tag and pull credential issues using fake credentials.

tasks.title: K8S-13.3 — Pending Pod Incident
tasks.objective: Diagnose scheduling failures from events and node capacity.

tasks.title: K8S-13.4 — OOMKilled Incident
tasks.objective: Investigate memory limits and application behavior; verify remediation.

tasks.title: K8S-13.5 — Service Connectivity Incident
tasks.objective: Find a selector, port or endpoint mismatch.

tasks.title: K8S-13.6 — DNS Failure Incident
tasks.objective: Diagnose broken service discovery and CoreDNS symptoms.

tasks.title: K8S-13.7 — Node Failure Incident
tasks.objective: Simulate a disposable worker outage and observe recovery.

tasks.title: K8S-13.8 — Multi-Symptom Production Outage
tasks.objective: Combine faults; triage, mitigate, recover, write an RCA and interview summary.

phases.title: K8S-14 — Backup, Restore & Disaster Recovery
phases.objective: Build hands-on Kubernetes production operations skills in backup, restore & disaster recovery, including controlled failures, diagnosis, verification, and documentation.

tasks.title: K8S-14.1 — Recovery Objectives and Data Inventory
tasks.objective: Define RPO/RTO and identify what must be backed up.

tasks.title: K8S-14.2 — Kubernetes Manifest Backup
tasks.objective: Export and version sanitized declarative workload configuration.

tasks.title: K8S-14.3 — Persistent Data Backup
tasks.objective: Back up sample application data from a local volume.

tasks.title: K8S-14.4 — Application Restore Exercise
tasks.objective: Restore manifests and data into a clean namespace or disposable cluster.

tasks.title: K8S-14.5 — Stateful Workload Recovery
tasks.objective: Test StatefulSet data recovery and verify application consistency.

tasks.title: K8S-14.6 — Cluster Recovery Planning
tasks.objective: Document managed-cloud vs kind control plane recovery boundaries.

tasks.title: K8S-14.7 — Backup Verification and Security
tasks.objective: Check backup integrity and avoid committing sensitive data.

tasks.title: K8S-14.8 — Disaster Recovery Simulation
tasks.objective: Recreate a lost workload from backups and record actual recovery time.

phases.title: K8S-15 — Operational Runbooks & Documentation
phases.objective: Build hands-on Kubernetes production operations skills in operational runbooks & documentation, including controlled failures, diagnosis, verification, and documentation.

tasks.title: K8S-15.1 — Cluster Health Runbook
tasks.objective: Document daily cluster health commands and expected results.

tasks.title: K8S-15.2 — Pod Failure Runbook
tasks.objective: Write symptom-to-command flow for CrashLoopBackOff and image failures.

tasks.title: K8S-15.3 — Scheduling and Resource Runbook
tasks.objective: Document Pending, OOMKilled, throttling and node pressure triage.

tasks.title: K8S-15.4 — Networking and DNS Runbook
tasks.objective: Document Service, Ingress, EndpointSlice and DNS troubleshooting.

tasks.title: K8S-15.5 — Storage Recovery Runbook
tasks.objective: Document PVC binding, mount failures and data recovery.

tasks.title: K8S-15.6 — Maintenance and Upgrade Runbook
tasks.objective: Record drain, PDB, upgrades, validation and rollback procedures.

tasks.title: K8S-15.7 — Incident Report Templates
tasks.objective: Create incident timeline, impact, RCA and action-item templates.

tasks.title: K8S-15.8 — Portfolio Documentation and Interview Notes
tasks.objective: Publish sanitized diagrams, lab results and short speakable incident summaries.
